## 1st Place Crown on Minimap and Nametags

Makes it so a crown is shown on the character head of the player in 1st place on the minimap and on the nametag as well.

You can choose if you only want it on minimap, nametag or both at the same time.

Requires custom Race.szs assets, so file modification is necessary. Those assets can be found in the Assets folder.
